title: HostedOrganizationRequired
description: The machine-readable code Cloud puts on its missing-organization answer, and the message the Worker gives a tools/call caller when it maps that answer to a tool error. The code is the PROPOSED meshery/schemas code name; it is not published there yet. Once Cloud lands a definition in meshery/schemas, replace this file with the vendored definition (hosted/schemas/vendor/) and read the code from it.
